Rowan: Quick announce — Leadership Sync this Fri 9:30am PT (hybrid). Goal: 30m briefing + 20m open Q&A. Please throw agenda items below or into the intake form.
CalendarBot: Event created — https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/lead-sync-2234567890 (Room C + dial-in).
Priya: Requesting a 7-min product update for the new fallback routing rule and rollout dates. I can demo the dashboard.
Elliot: Ill cover Dedicated capacity forecasts (3m) and highlight any expected shortfalls next quarter.
Nina: I'm flagging a short incident postmortem from yesterdays degraded KV cache hit rates. Want to include a 2-min recap + mitigation steps.
Lena: Ops note: we'll publish a short playbook for customers if we change fallbacks. Can someone draft a one-paragraph blurb for the handbook?
Priya: Draft agenda (very tight):
```
1) Exec brief (Rowan)  8m
2) Product: fallback routing + demo (Priya)  7m
3) Capacity update (Elliot)  3m
4) Reliability snapshot & postmortem (Nina)  2m
5) Customer comms playbook (Lena)  5m
6) Open Q&A (all)  20m
```
Rowan: Looks good. Keep slides to 5 or fewer. If any content touches customer PII/security, mark it and we'll handle offline.
Nina: For the incident recap, I'll include a single timeline + remediation bullets. OpsBot: Incident ID INC-2026-042 posted to #incidents — summary attached.
Priya: Qs to seed the form: "How does fallback routing affect token billing?", "Will there be model parity across regions?"
Lena: Also ask: "How will Dedicated customers be notified of config changes?"
Rowan: Please submit decks & the intake form by Thu 5pm PT. Intake form: https://forms.redwood.ai/lead-sync-qa-2234567890
Elliot: If you're presenting demos that need GPU access, ping eng-infra asap.
Lena: I'll handle recording + captions. Recording will be posted in this channel and attached to the handbook page within 24h.
Priya: Tiny ask: can speakers upload slides by Thu noon so captions and speaker metadata get baked in?
Rowan: Thanks — final agenda will go out Fri 7am PT. We'll prioritize pre-submitted questions during the Q&A.
Nina: Adding a note: we'll avoid naming customers in the public recap unless theyve signed off.
Priya: I'll attach a 1-slide before EOD Thu for review.
Rowan: Great. See you Friday. :sparkles:
